painHook.title:
Kamu mematikan alarm.

alarmCount.title: How many alarms do you set?

oneAlarmTrust.title: Would one alarm actually wake you?

insight.title: This isn’t a motivation problem.
insight.copy: When the alarm rings, your brain is still waking up. That’s why half-asleep taps win.

options.snooze_unaware: Aku menekan tunda tanpa benar-benar ingat
options.multiple_alarms: Aku memasang banyak alarm dan mengabaikan semuanya

options.sleepy_ignores: Diriku yang mengantuk mengabaikan rencana malamku

personalizedSolution.title: Each pattern, and what beats it.

solutions.snooze_unaware: The mission interrupts the snooze loop
solutions.dismiss_fall_asleep: The tap alone can’t end the wake-up
solutions.multiple_alarms: One action-based alarm replaces the chain
solutions.louder_background: Change what you do, not the volume
solutions.late_frustrated: One completed action starts the morning
